material_units.source_text:
Theorem — Kernel ridge regression equals the GP posterior mean
      The minimiser of $\sum_{i=1}^t(y_i-f(x_i))^2+\lambda\|f\|_k^2$ over $f\in\mathcal H_k$ is $f^\star(x)=k_t(x)^\top(K_t+\lambda I)^{-1}y_t=\mu_t(x)$. (Kanagawa, Hennig, Sejdinovic & Sriperumbudur (2018) give the full dictionary between the GP and the kernel view, including the sample-path facts used above.)
